m: वर्गा (आ), f. N. of an Apsaras, MBh.
वर्गान्त्य m. (in gram.) the last letter of a Varga, a nasal, APrāt., Sch.
वर्गाष्टक n. the eight groups of consonants i.e. the consonants collectively, RāmatUp., Sch.
वर्गीण mfn. (ifc.) belonging to the class or category or family or party of Pāṇ. iv, 3, 64.
a: वर्गीण — a. Belonging to a class or category.

m: वर्गी-कृत mfn. made into classes, classified, arranged, MW.
(in alg.) raised to a square, squared.
वर्गीय mfn. (ifc.) id., ib. (e.g. क-वर्गीय, a guttural, च-वर्गीय, a palatal Sch.; cf. अर्थ-, मद्-व्˚ &c.)
a: वर्गीय — a. Belonging to a class or category. --यः A class-fellow.

s: puM, (vfjyate iti । vfjI varjjane + GaY .) svajAtIyasamUhaH । (yaTA, raGuH । 2 । 4 । “vratAya tenAnucareRa DenornyazeDi Sezo'pyanuyAyivargaH ॥”) samAnaDarmmiBiH prARiBiraprARiBirupalakzitaM vfndam । yaTA kavargaH । atra katvaKatvAdinA vijAtIyatve'pi sTAnasAmyamasti । ityamaraBaratO ॥ granTaparicCedaH । yaTA, -- “sargo vargaparicCedodGAtADyAyANkasaMgrahAH । ucCvAsaH parivarttaSca pawalaH kARqamastriyAm । sTAnaM prakaraRaM parvvAhrikaYca granTasanDayaH ॥” iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ samAnANkadvayasya pUraRam । tatparyyAyaH । kftiH 2 । varge karaRasUtraM vfttadvayam । “samadviGAtaH kftirucyate'Ta sTApyo'ntyavargo dviguRAntyaniGnaH । svasvoparizwAcca taTApare'NkAstyaktvAntyamutsAryya punaSca rASim ॥ KaRqadvayasyABihatirdviniGnI tatKaRqavargEkyayutA kftirvvA । izwonayugrASivaDaHkfti syAdizwasya vargeRa samanvito vA ॥” * ॥ atroddeSakaH । “saKe navAnAYca caturddaSAnAM brUhi trihInasya Satatrayasya । paYcottarasyApyayutasya vargaM jAnAsi cedvargaviDAnamArgam ॥” nyAmaH 9 । 14 । 297 । 10005 । ezAM yaToktakaraRena jAtA vargAH 81 । 196 । 88209 । 100100025 ॥ aTavA navAnAM KaRqe 4 । 5 । anayorAhatiH 20 । dbiniGnI 40 । tatKaRqavargEkyena 41 । yutA jAtA sEva kfti 81 ॥ aTavA caturddaSAnAM KaRqe 6 । 8 । anayorAhatiH 48 । dbiniGnI 96 । tatKaRqavargO 36 । 64 । anayorEkyena 100 । yutA jAtA sEva kftiH 196 ॥ aTavA KaRqe 4 । 10 । taTApi sEva kftiH 196 ॥ aTavA rASiH 297 ॥ ayaM triBirUnaH pfTagyutaSca 294 । 300 । anayorGAtaH 88200 । trivarga 9 yuto jAto vargaH sa eva 88209 ॥ evaM sarvvatrApi iti lIlAvatyAM vargaH ॥ (strI, apsaroviSezaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 217 । 15 । “apsarAsmi mahAbAho devAraRyavihAriRI । izwA DanapaternityaM vargA nAma mahAvala ॥” muniSApAtgrAharUpiRIyaM arjjunAt SApamuktAsIt । etadvfttAntantu tatrEva drazwavyam ॥)
v: pu॰ vfja--GaY । 1 sajAtIyasamUhe amaraH । yaTA manuzyavargaH paSuvargaH । samAnaDarmiBiH prARyaprARiBiH kfte 2 saMGe ca yaTA kavargaH cavargaH । atra katvalatvAdinA vijAtIyatve'pi sTAnasAmyamasti । 3 granTaparicCede yaTA svargavargaH pAtAlavargaH । 4 aNkaSAstrokte samAnANkadvayasya paramparaguRane yaTA dvikasya catvAri, trikasya nava, catuzkasya zoqaSa ityAdi । “sTApyo'ntyavargaH” “vargaM mUlaM padaM kftim” iti ca lIlA॰ । vfja--GaY । 5 tyAge । granTa paricCedASca bahuviDAH yaTA “sargovargapalicCedodGAtADyAyANkasaMgrahAH । ucCvAsaH parivarttaSca pawalaH kARqamastriyAm । sTAnaM prakaraRaM parvAhRikaYca granTasanDayaH” trikA॰ ।
m: वर्ग m. (accented only in Nigh.) (fr. √ वृज्) one who excludes or removes or averts, KauṣUp.

(ifc. f(आ). ) a separate division, class, set, multitude of similar things (animate or inanimate), group, company, family, party, side (mostly ifc., e.g. चतुर्-, त्रि-व्˚, q.v.; often pl. for sg.), KātyŚr.; Prāt. &c.

(esp.) any series or group of words classified together (as मनुष्य-वनस्-पति-व्˚ &c.), or a class or series of consonants in the alphabet (seven such classes being given, viz. क-वर्ग, ‘the class of Guttural letters’ च-कार-व्˚, or च-व्˚, ‘the Palatals’ ; ट-व्˚ ‘the Cerebrals’; त-व्˚ ‘the Dentals’; प-व्˚ ‘the Labials’; य-व्˚ ‘the Semivowels’; श-व्˚ ‘the Sibilants’, and the aspirate ह् cf. वर्ग-द्वितीय and -प्रथम), Prāt.; VarBṛS.; Vop.
everything comprehended under any department or head, everything included under a category, province or sphere of VarBṛS.
= त्रि-वर्ग (q.v.), BhP.

a section, chapter, division of a book, (esp.) a subdivision of an Adhyāya in the Ṛg-veda (which accord. to the mere mechanical division, contains 8 Āṣṭakas or 64 Adhyāyas or 2006 Vargas; cf. मण्डल) and a similar subdivision in the Bṛhad-devatā
(in alg.) the square of a number, Col. (e.g. पञ्च-व्˚, square of five, cf. भिन्न-व्˚)
= बल, strength, Naigh. ii, 9
N. of a country, Buddh.
a: वर्गः — [वृज्-घञ्] 1 A class, division, group; company, society, tribe, collection (of similar things); न्यषेधि शेषोऽप्यनुयायिवर्गः R. 2. 4, 11. 7; so पौरवर्गः, नक्षत्रवर्गः &c. --2 A party, side; Ku. 7. 53. --3 A category. --4 A class of words grouped together; as मनुष्यवर्गः, वनस्पतिवर्गः &c. --5 A class of consonants in the alphabet. --6 A section, chapter, division of a book. --7 Particularly, a subdivision of an Adhyāya in Ṛgveda. --8 The square power. --9 Strength. --10 Sphere, province. --11 The whole class of objects of worldly existence (धर्म, अर्थ, and काम). --Comp. --अंत्यं, --उत्तमं the last letter of each of the first five classes of consonants; i. e. a nasal. --घनः the cube of a square. ˚घातः the fifth power. --पदं, --मूलं the square root. --प्रकृतिः f. an affected square. --वर्गः the square of a square.

k.v: वृन्दभेदाः समैर्वर्गः सङ्घसार्थौ तु जन्तुभिः। सजातीयैः कुलं यूथं तिरश्चां पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

m: वर्ग—घन n. the square of a cube, W.
वर्ग—घन—घात m. (in arithm.) the fifth power.
वर्गणा f. division, class, Śīl.
multiplication, VarBṛS.
वर्ग—शस् ind. accord. to divisions, in groups, BhP.
a: वर्गशस् — ind. In groups, according to classes.

m: वर्ग—द्वितीय m. (in gram.) the second letter of a Varga (see above).
वर्ग—कर्मन् n. N. of an indefinite problem or of an operation relating to square numbers, Līl.

m: वर्ग—मूल n. (in arithm.) square root, Col.
वर्ग—पद n. a square root, Col.

वर्ग—प्रकृति f. (in arithm.) an affected square, Col.

a: वर्गिन् — a. Belonging to a class or party.

s: puM, (vargezu uttamaH .) carARAM arTAt mezakarkkawatulAmakararASInAM praTamo'MSaH । sTirARAM arTAdvfzasiMhavfScikakumBarASInAM paYcamo'MSaH । dvyAtmakAnAM arTAt miTunakanyADanurmInarASInAM navamo'MSaSca । yaTA, -- “carARAM praTame cAMSe sTirARAM paYcame taTA । navame dvyAtmakAnAYca vargottama iti smftaH ॥” api ca । rASInAM svakIyanavAMSaH । yaTA, -- “svanavAMSastu rASInAM vargottama iti smftaH ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥
v: pu॰ vargezu zawsu kzetrAdizu uttamaH mavAMSaH । “carARAM praTame cAMSe sTirARAM paYcame taTA । hyAtmakAnAYca navame vargottama iti smftaH” iti jyotizokte triMSAMSakAtmakarASernavAMSaBede ।
m: वर्गोत्तम m. = वर्गान्त्य, APrāt., Sch.
(in astrol.) ‘chief of a class’, N. of the Ram and the Bull and the Twins (being the first in a partic. grouping of the zodiacal signs), Var.
वर्ग्य mfn. (ifc.) id., Pāṇ. iv, 3, 54 (cf. मद्-व्˚)
वर्ग्य m. a member of a society, colleague, Mālatīm.
a: वर्ग्य — a. Belonging to the same class. --र्ग्यः One belonging to the same class or company, colleague, class-fellow, fellow-student (in learning); या यस्य युज्यते भूमिका तां खलु भावेन तथैव सर्वे वर्ग्याः पाठिताः Māl. 1; उद्बाहुना जुहुविरे मुहुरात्मवर्ग्याः Śi. 5. 15.
